red.name: bash
red.run: rc=0; tmp=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT; while IFS= read -r -d '' t; do TAP_OUT=$tmp bash "$t" </dev/null || rc=1; done < <(git diff -z --name-only --diff-filter=AMRC HEAD^ HEAD -- ':(glob)**/test-*.sh'); { echo '<testsuites>'; cat "$tmp"; echo '</testsuites>'; } >{out}; exit $rc
